design_direction: Distinct automotive design: graphite, chrome and electric blue, bold sans-serif typography, original side-profile vehicle illustration, interactive accessible service selector, compact contact section. No fake booking or fabricated results.

opportunity.observation: The desktop landing page begins with a Wix builder advertisement, repeated business-name welcome heading, social widget and gallery. No direct phone action appears in the initial viewport. Services contain visible spelling mistakes and contact is much farther down. The proposal uses a concise detailing offer, explicit call action and clearer service categories; no claim of measured conversion loss.
opportunity.comparison_evidence: Direct desktop browser screenshot plus the mobile final screenshot in a current PageSpeed Insights report inspected. Both initial views lack a visible direct phone action. The current site works; the proposed improvement is clearer contact hierarchy, not an assertion of measured sales loss.
opportunity.reason: The business-owned page lists Manchester location, a public email and phone, and its services. Bounded Gmail identity/address search found no prior correspondence. Genuine business lead with an observable presentation opportunity; buying interest remains unknown.
